summary: Cosign HSM epoch skew causes signature validation to fail, blocking container promotion
summary_extended: During a scheduled PKCS#11 HSM key rotation the cosign signer on CI produced valid signatures but subsequent verification by the promotion job failed with epoch/time-window errors, preventing any container images from being promoted to the release registry.
description:
Issue summary:
- What happened: Automated container promotion jobs started failing verification immediately after the HSM key rollover window. The cosign signing step reports success, push to registry succeeds, but the promotion verification step (post-push policy) rejects the image.
- Impact: Blocked promotion pipeline for all releases targeting the us-east release cohort. Approximately 12 release candidates queued; customers on internal canary cannot be promoted. No pod rollouts happened.
- First observed: 2026-03-13 02:17 UTC when nightly canary promotion aborted.
- Temporary scope: prod us-east artifact-registry and the cosign signer instances used by CI runners.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Trigger standard build pipeline that signs with cosign (PKCS#11-backed key).
2) After HSM rotation window, run the promotion job that invokes 'cosign verify' against the registry entry.
3) Observe verification failure with epoch/skew related message.

Observed error: 'cosign: signature verification failed: verification time 1678793820 not within validity window [1678797600, 1678801200]' (timestamps are examples).
logs:
ci-runner-42 cosign: signing completed (signature stored in registry).
promotion-job-17 verify: ERROR cosign: signature validation failed: verification time 170 - outside allowed window
hsm-proxy: PKCS11: login successful, keyslot 2 pulled, keyid=ae3f2b..
registry-policy: reject image sha256:... - signature epoch mismatch
(see attached truncated logs in S3 bucket: s3://redwood-internal/incident/INT-981345/logs.tar.gz)
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: HSM returned signatures with a future 'notBefore'/epoch due to clock skew or a transient signing policy during the rotation.
- Checked HSM NTP sync across HSM cluster nodes via runbook; one partition showed drift of ~4 minutes during the window.
- PKCS#11 driver reported successful rotation and new key label 'cosign-2026-03-13'.
- Cosign signer config uses server-local time for validity checks when generating 'signedTime' metadata; the promotion job uses verifier time derived from registry verification service (which is strictly NTP-synced).
- Reproduced locally by forcing signer time ahead by 5 minutes; verifier rejects.
Links: Slack thread #release-ops: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/release-ops/p1234567890
Runbook ref: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ENG/Cosign+HSM+rotation+runbook
comments: Asha Patel (reporter) 2026-03-13: Opened after nightlies failed. Initial triage points to HSM rotation window coincident with signing. Pls escalate to crypto and infra.

Liam O'Connor (assignee) 2026-03-13: I will take this. Spun up a temporary cosign signer using software key to verify promotion path works end-to-end. Verified that software-signed images verify fine — indicates signing metadata from HSM differs from expected time window.
Crypto Team (comment) 2026-03-13: HSM cluster completed rewrap and key push at 02:12 UTC. We saw a short NTP hiccup on node hsm-03. Investigating firmware logs for 'sign time' stamping behavior.
SRE (comment) 2026-03-13: NTP on hsm-03 drifted ~240s starting 02:10 UTC during maintenance. We've re-synced and restarted ntpd. Monitoring.

Liam O'Connor 2026-03-14: Temporary mitigation: pinned CI cosign signer to software key for releases until HSM firmware patch applied. Created PR to add 5m tolerance to internal policy verifier as short-term workaround (see PR).
resolution:
Workaround applied 2026-03-14: CI promotion pipelines switched to software-backed cosign signer for critical releases; promotion resumed for queued images.
Permanent fix: Crypto/SRE to apply HSM firmware patch and enforce tighter NTP monitoring with alerting. Also created a change to the promotion verifier to allow configurable verification_time_tolerance (default 0s) for an emergency-release window; PR merged with a 5m emergency tolerance and requires a follow-up rollback after HSM patch.
Post-actions: schedule postmortem with crypto and release-eng within 72h, update cosign HSM rotation runbook to include pre-rotation NTP sanity check step.
next_steps:
1) Crypto to apply HSM firmware patch and confirm NTP stability on all partitions.
2) SRE to add an alert for clock drift >30s on HSM fleet.
3) Release eng to coordinate rollback of verifier tolerance after patch.
4) Postmortem scheduled and runbook updated.
customer_impact_note: Internal canary/promote only — no external customer invoices or billing impacts. Some teams waiting on promotions for staging-to-prod release gating.
